scripts.free-port: powershell -Command "$processId = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess; if ($processId) { Stop-Process -Id $processId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Process using port 3000 terminated.' } else { Write-Host 'No process using port 3000.' }"
scripts.dev: npm run free-port && echo Puerto libre, iniciando backend... && ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only src/index.ts
scripts.dev:ssh: npm run free-port && echo Puerto libre, iniciando backend con túnel SSH... && ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only src/index.ts
scripts.seed:local: cross-env NODE_ENV_DB_PATH=.env.local npx prisma db seed
scripts.dev:local-direct: npm run free-port && cross-env NODE_ENV_DB_PATH=.env.local ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only src/index.ts
scripts.start:local: npm run free-port && echo Puerto libre, iniciando backend... && node scripts/copy-env.js local && npm run start
scripts.start:cloud: npm run free-port && echo Puerto libre, iniciando backend... && node scripts/copy-env.js cloud && npm run start
scripts.dev:local: node scripts/copy-env.js local && npm run dev
scripts.dev:cloud: node scripts/copy-env.js cloud && npm run dev
